references.text: Gold is used to cover the ark of the covenant, showing the consistent pattern of covering holy objects with gold in the tabernacle.
Gold rings are made for the ark of the covenant, corresponding to the gold rings that are to be made for the boards.
Poles covered with gold are used to carry the ark of the covenant, parallel to the gold-covered crossbars for the boards.
Describes the crossbars that are to go through the rings mentioned in verse 29.
The incense altar also has poles covered with gold, showing the same pattern of gold-covered poles.
Fulfillment of the command in 26:29, where the boards, rings, and crossbars were actually covered with gold.
Solomon's temple was covered with gold on the inside, continuing the tradition of gold covering from the tabernacle.
Both verses illustrate the consistent theological principle that the entire structure of the sanctuary (both walls and entrance) must be covered in gold to reflect God's presence.
